lines.zh: 我贴着落叶层走，鼻子一直在嗅。
lines.en: I hug the leaf litter, nose working the whole way.

lines.zh: 尖刺刮过草丛，沙沙地响。
lines.en: My spines rake the grass with a dry rustle.

lines.zh: 松针底下有甜浆果的味道。
lines.en: Under the pine needles there is a smell of sweet berries.

lines.zh: 我迈着小短腿，绕过每块石头。
lines.en: On short legs, I walk around every stone.

lines.zh: 别看我慢，我一路都在闻。
lines.en: Slow as I am, I sniff the whole way.

lines.zh: 树根这里有虫子的气息。
lines.en: There is a wormy smell here by the roots.

lines.zh: 我把肚子贴得很低，怕被看见。
lines.en: I keep my belly low so nothing sees me.

lines.zh: 这片林地我熟，闭着眼也能走。
lines.en: I know this wood well enough to walk it blind.

lines.zh: 走到蘑菇旁边，我停下来嗅了嗅。
lines.en: By a mushroom I stop and sniff it twice.

lines.zh: 刺上挂着两片枯叶，我不在意。
lines.en: Two dead leaves hang on my spines; I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我沿倒木边缘走，那里更安全。
lines.en: I walk the edge of the fallen log, where it is safer.

lines.zh: 腐叶下面藏着浆果的甜味。
lines.en: Sweet berry scent hides beneath the rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 夜露打湿了我的刺，有点凉。
lines.en: Night dew wets my spines and chills me a little.

lines.zh: 前面有块空地，我先探头看看。
lines.en: A clearing opens ahead; I poke my nose out first.

lines.zh: 我钻进落叶堆，又探出头
lines.en: I burrow into the leaf litter and poke my head out.

lines.zh: 前爪刨了两下，土松了
lines.en: Two scrapes of my forepaws and the soil loosens.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，只露出鼻尖。
lines.en: I curl into a ball with only my nose showing.

lines.zh: 嗅一嗅，再嗅一嗅，什么都没有。
lines.en: Sniff, sniff again, and there is nothing there.

lines.zh: 风把树叶吹到我背上，扎住了。
lines.en: The wind blows a leaf onto my back and it sticks.

lines.zh: 我数着远处滴水的声音。
lines.en: I count the sound of water dripping far off.

lines.zh: 肚子里空空的，想找颗甜浆果。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I want one sweet berry.

lines.zh: 有人靠近，我先把刺竖起来。
lines.en: Something comes near, so up go my spines.

lines.zh: 这丛草够高，能把我藏住。
lines.en: This clump of grass is tall enough to hide me.

lines.zh: 我打个小小的喷嚏，刺抖了一下。
lines.en: I sneeze a tiny sneeze and my spines shiver.

lines.zh: 月光落在刺尖上，亮亮的。
lines.en: Moonlight sits on my spine tips, bright and cold.

lines.zh: 刚才那只甲虫钻到哪去了？
lines.en: Where did that beetle scuttle off to?

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，假装自己是石头。
lines.en: I blink slowly and pretend to be a stone.

lines.zh: 背上的刺碰着树皮，咔的一声。
lines.en: My spines knock the bark with a small click.

lines.zh: 你手里没有瓶子吧？我盯着看。
lines.en: You have no bottle, do you? I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，鼻子动个不停。
lines.en: I look up at you, nose twitching without pause.

lines.zh: 你脚步声太重，我早听见了。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy; I heard them long ago.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来的样子，比我高好多。
lines.en: Even crouched, you are so much taller than me.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的刺可不是装饰。
lines.en: Don't reach out; my spines are not decoration.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾着草籽，我闻到了。
lines.en: There are grass seeds on your boots; I smell them.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，猜你会不会踩过来。
lines.en: Head tilted, I wonder if you will step this way.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 你掌心有浆果味吗？让我闻闻。
lines.en: Do your palms smell of berries? Let me check.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的玻璃瓶，往后退了退。
lines.en: I eye your glass bottle and shuffle backwards.

lines.zh: 疼！我的刺都软了一下。
lines.en: Ouch! Even my spines went slack for a moment.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，可还是被找到了。
lines.en: I curl into a ball and still get found.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我大概撑不住。
lines.en: This much damage, and I likely will not last.

lines.zh: 血流进落叶里，没人看见。
lines.en: My blood runs into the leaves where no one sees.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，声音细得像风。
lines.en: I huff, a sound as thin as the wind.

lines.zh: 别打了，我只有四点的命。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I have only four points of life.

lines.zh: 刺歪了一根，扎到自己了。
lines.en: One spine bent and pricked me instead.

lines.zh: 我想跑，可腿在抖。
lines.en: I want to run, but my legs are shaking.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起被踩的那天。
lines.en: That blow brings back the day I was stepped on.

lines.zh: 我还能嗅，就还活着。
lines.en: As long as I can still sniff, I am alive.

lines.zh: 甜浆果！我闻到那股酸甜了。
lines.en: Sweet berries! I catch that sour-sweet smell.

lines.zh: 你晃那颗浆果，我腿就软了。
lines.en: You wave that berry and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 给我一颗，我就跟你走一段。
lines.en: Give me one and I will follow you a while.

lines.zh: 红色的汁水，看着就甜。
lines.en: That red juice looks sweet from here.

lines.zh: 浆果在你掌心，我的腿比嘴快。
lines.en: The berry sits in your palm; my legs outrun my mouth.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了要竖刺。
lines.en: This smell makes me forget to raise my spines.

lines.zh: 你放低一点，我胆子就大了。
lines.en: Lower it a little and I grow brave.

lines.zh: 我小跑过去，刺都顺了下来。
lines.en: I trot over with all my spines laid flat.

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就要咬住它了。
lines.en: One step closer and I will bite it.

lines.zh: 为了浆果，我连危险都不管。
lines.en: For a berry I will ignore the danger.

lines.zh: 哎！你的靴子压到我的刺了！
lines.en: Hey! Your boot is pressing on my spines!

lines.zh: 我竖起全身的刺，你也疼了吧？
lines.en: I bristle all over; that hurt you too, didn't it?

lines.zh: 被踩这一下，我连气都喘不上。
lines.en: That step knocked the breath right out of me.

lines.zh: 别退，我的刺已经扎进你鞋底。
lines.en: Don't pull back; my spines are in your sole.

lines.zh: 我反抗了，可我自己也活不成。
lines.en: I fought back, and now I will not survive it.

lines.zh: 这一脚太沉，我的骨头在响。
lines.en: That foot was too heavy; my bones are clicking.

lines.zh: 你跳开时，我滚进了落叶里。
lines.en: When you jumped away, I rolled into the leaves.

lines.zh: 我缩成球，你还是踢到了我。
lines.en: I curled into a ball and you still kicked me.

lines.zh: 刺扎出去的同时，我也在流血。
lines.en: The spines went out, and I bled with them.

lines.zh: 下次走路，看看脚下好不好？
lines.en: Next time, would you look at your feet?

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，让我想找个伴。
lines.en: The smell of sweet berries makes me want a mate.

lines.zh: 我在落叶里转圈，刺蹭着刺。
lines.en: I circle in the leaves, spine brushing spine.

lines.zh: 她缩成球，我也缩成球。
lines.en: She curls into a ball, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我们鼻子碰鼻子，谁都不说话。
lines.en: Nose to nose, neither of us makes a sound.

lines.zh: 这丛蕨类够隐蔽，就这里吧。
lines.en: This fern clump hides us well; here, then.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖推了推她的背。
lines.en: I nudge her back with the tip of my nose.

lines.zh: 两颗浆果，一颗给她，一颗留着。
lines.en: Two berries: one for her, one saved for later.

lines.zh: 夜里的林子，只听见我们的嗅声。
lines.en: In the night wood only our sniffing is heard.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我们这时候很敏感。
lines.en: Don't come close; we are touchy just now.

lines.zh: 小刺猬会自己找虫吃，不用教。
lines.en: The little ones find their own worms, no lessons needed.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只能叼一颗浆果，别笑。
lines.en: I can carry one berry in my mouth; don't laugh.

lines.zh: 刺上挂住的东西，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Whatever snags my spines, I cannot shake off.

lines.zh: 这片叶子黏在我背上，算了。
lines.en: This leaf is stuck to my back; leave it.

lines.zh: 我试着叼起蘑菇，太重了。
lines.en: I try to lift a mushroom and it is far too heavy.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的浆果，归我了。
lines.en: The berry on the ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住它，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I pin it with a front paw and nibble slowly.

lines.zh: 这根草茎卡在刺里，有点痒。
lines.en: A stem is caught in my spines and it itches.

lines.zh: 我拖着一片树皮走了两步。
lines.en: I drag a strip of bark along for two steps.

lines.zh: 捡东西这事，我实在不擅长。
lines.en: Picking things up is really not my talent.

lines.zh: 嘴里塞满了，我说话都含糊。
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I mumble everything.

lines.zh: 谁踩我？我记住这只靴子了。
lines.en: Who stepped on me? I know that boot now.

lines.zh: 刺已经竖好，等你再靠近一步。
lines.en: Spines are up; come one step closer.

lines.zh: 我记住你的靴子了，等着瞧。
lines.en: I have memorized your boot; just you wait.

lines.zh: 刚才那脚，我要还回去一点。
lines.en: For that step, I will give a little back.

lines.zh: 你踩下来的影子，我看得清楚。
lines.en: I see your shadow coming down quite clearly.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，准备撞你的脚。
lines.en: I crouch low, ready to butt your foot.

lines.zh: 目标不大，就是你的脚踝。
lines.en: My target is small: just your ankle.

lines.zh: 我发出细细的哼声，警告一次。
lines.en: I give one thin warning huff.

lines.zh: 别以为我小就不会还手。
lines.en: Do not think small means I will not fight.

lines.zh: 这一下我要用背上的刺。
lines.en: For this one I will use the spines on my back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到你鞋边，找角度。
lines.en: I shift to your shoe and hunt for an angle.

lines.zh: 刺朝上，等你踩下来的那刻。
lines.en: Spines up, waiting for the moment you step.

lines.zh: 你的脚一动，我就跟着转。
lines.en: When your foot moves, I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我在数你抬脚的节奏。
lines.en: I am counting the rhythm of your footsteps.

lines.zh: 再往前半步，我就顶上去。
lines.en: Half a step more and I push up into you.

lines.zh: 我绕到你脚后跟，那里软。
lines.en: I slip behind your heel, where it is soft.

lines.zh: 呼吸放轻，别让你先发现。
lines.en: I breathe softly so you notice nothing.

lines.zh: 刺尖对着你的靴缝，刚好。
lines.en: My spine tips line up with the seam of your boot.

lines.zh: 你一停，我也停，别急。
lines.en: You stop, I stop; no need to hurry.

lines.zh: 我这一撞，大概只能疼你一下。
lines.en: My charge will only sting you for a moment.

lines.zh: 我整个背撞上你的脚背！
lines.en: I ram my whole back into your foot!

lines.zh: 刺扎进去的那下，我听见你吸气。
lines.en: When the spines sank in, I heard you gasp.

lines.zh: 我弹起来，像颗带刺的果子。
lines.en: I bounce up like a spiny little fruit.

lines.zh: 这一下用尽了我所有力气。
lines.en: That one took every bit of strength I have.

lines.zh: 扎完我自己也翻了个跟头。
lines.en: After the jab I tumbled head over heels.

lines.zh: 你踢开我时，我还咬着你的鞋带。
lines.en: When you kicked me off, I still had your lace.

lines.zh: 我的刺留在你裤脚上了。
lines.en: One of my spines stayed on your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我也疼，可我不退。
lines.en: Does it hurt? So do I, and still I stand.

lines.zh: 再来一次，我就没力气了。
lines.en: One more and I will have nothing left.

lines.zh: 小小的身体，也能扎出血点。
lines.en: A tiny body can still draw a bead of blood.

lines.zh: 我从落叶堆里钻出来，天刚暗。
lines.en: I climb out of the leaf pile as the light fades.

lines.zh: 这片森林的腐叶味，我认得。
lines.en: I know this forest by the smell of rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我出生在一棵老橡树根下。
lines.en: I was born beneath the roots of an old oak.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，先闻到潮湿的泥土。
lines.en: I open my eyes and smell wet earth first.

lines.zh: 刺还是软的，我得慢慢长大。
lines.en: My spines are still soft; I must grow slowly.

lines.zh: 林子这么深，正合我意。
lines.en: The wood is this deep, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找颗甜浆果。
lines.en: First thing: find one sweet berry.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的松针，出发了。
lines.en: I shake the pine needles off and set out.

lines.zh: 夜色下来，我的鼻子先醒。
lines.en: Night falls and my nose wakes before the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这附近有浆果丛，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is a berry bush nearby; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 刺烧焦的味道，比什么都难闻。
lines.en: The smell of burnt spines is the worst of all.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，刺全扎进土里。
lines.en: I roll downhill and every spine digs into the dirt.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我扑腾不起来。
lines.en: Water pours into my nose and I cannot paddle up.

lines.zh: 一声巨响，我被掀进了树丛。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the thicket.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我刺上，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my spines and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那股怪味钻进鼻子，我晕了。
lines.en: A strange smell crawls up my nose and I faint.

lines.zh: 找不到甜浆果，我的肚子贴到背上。
lines.en: No sweet berries anywhere; my belly touches my spine.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的刺全竖成了焦黑。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my spines stand up charred.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，连落叶的味道都没了。
lines.en: I fall, and even the smell of leaves is gone.
